name: Scritch
title: Ruin Scavenger
description: A wiry goblin in a black barrel-armor, scavenging the ruins with surprising cunning.
greeting_variants: *hisses* My barrel! Finders keepers! You no take!
Shiny-shiny? You got? Scritch trade, yes-yes!
*sniffs air* You smell... not-ruin. New-new. Interesting.
Big stompers everywhere. Scritch hide good. You hide good too?
*counts on fingers* One, two, MANY barrels of stuff! All Scritch's!
You fight the purple-eat? Scritch no like purple-eat. Bad-bad.
*peeks from barrel* Oh. Not food-boy. Disappoint.
Scritch know secrets! Secret paths! Secret stashes! You pay?

dialog_tree.text: Scritch live here first! Before big-folk, before purple-sky! Scritch know every crack, every hole, every secret-place! Big-folk stomp around, miss everything. Scritch find!
Oh, many-many! Shiny coins! Spark-boxes! Food-packs! Scritch find special thing too—round metal with numbers. Counts down, Scritch thinks. Very old. Very... important-feeling.

party_reactions.mira: A chronometer? From before the Cataclysm?
party_reactions.scritch: Chron... chron... time-thing! Yes! Counts to... something.

dialog_tree.text: Scritch trade! Shiny for food! Shiny for safe-pass! Shiny for... *leans in* ...information. Scritch hear things. See things. Know things big-folk don't.
Purple-eat come from up-up. Palace-place. Scritch remember... before, Palace pretty. Golden. Now... wrong. Scritch feel it. In barrel. In bones. Palace call things. Call them... home.

options.text: Can you show me a safe path?

mini_quest.title: The Scavenger's Collection
mini_quest.description: Help Scritch retrieve a special 'shiny-shiny' from a dangerous section of the ruins.
objectives: Navigate to the old treasury (guarded by void-touched creatures)
Choose: keep the orb or give it to Scritch

ambient_barks: *clinking from inside barrel* My precious... my precious...
Shh! Big-stomper patrol! Scritch small, Scritch hide!
Scritch saw tall-tall tower once. All colors. Pretty-scary.
You no tell others about Scritch stash! Secret!
Purple-ones walk funny. Like broken puppets. Scritch no like.
*hoarding sounds* One more, one more, then enough... maybe.
Food-boys have good-good scraps. Scritch trade for!

cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Scritch saw tower-people once! All same-same! Twins, they called. Creepy-same!
cross_zone_references.void_nexus: *shivers* Purple-deep bad. Scritch no go. Scritch smart. Smart goblins live.
cross_zone_references.palace: Palace... Scritch remember songs. Happy songs. Now... different songs. Hungry songs.

garret.response: *hisses* Little?! Scritch TALL! For goblin! Very tall!

kael.response: *surprised* Big-stomper... nice? Scritch confused. But happy-confused!

time_of_day.night: Active in shadows, raids food stores
